skill_cards.if_condition: When a full TCP port scan reveals open ports 22, 80, and 443
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with service detection and default scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service exposes login and forgotten-password endpoints
skill_cards.then_action: Use Medusa or Hydra with default creds dictionary for POST form

skill_cards.if_condition: When authenticated shell access is unavailable but writable directories are identified
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy linpeas.sh to surface privilege escalation vectors
